map.如何使用数独生成器？: How do I use Sudoku Generator?
map.数独生成器适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Sudoku Generator best for?
map.生成一个可打印的 9x9 数独谜题（本地可复现）: Generate a printable 9x9 Sudoku puzzle (locally reproducible)
map.数独生成按回溯法构造终盘：依次为每格试填 1 至 9，校验行、列、3×3 宫不冲: Sudoku is built by backtracking: fill 1–9 into each cell, checking no row/column/3x3 box conflict, backtracking on conflict; then remove givens by difficulty (easy keeps ~36–45, medium ~30–35, hard ~26–29), verifying uniqueness (solution count = 1) after each removal to guarantee a single answer.
map.先生成完整解盘，再按难度挖空（初级约挖 40 格、中级 50、高级 55+），保: First generate a full solution grid, then dig holes by difficulty (beginner ~40, intermediate 50, advanced 55+), and output the puzzle and answer only after confirming a unique solution.
map.选「中级」挖空 50 格：输出 9×9 盘面留 31 个提示数，附答案可对照；复: Pick 'Intermediate' and dig 50 cells: outputs a 9x9 board with 31 givens plus the answer for checking; copy to text or print to use. Higher difficulty means fewer givens.
map.题目一定有唯一解吗？: Is the puzzle guaranteed a unique solution?
map.生成时按唯一解校验，挖空过猛会自动回收以保证可解；极端设置可能放宽。: Generation validates uniqueness; over-digging auto-recovers to stay solvable; extreme settings may relax it.
map.当前生成可复制文本/可打印页面，纯前端；导出由浏览器打印功能完成。: It generates copyable text / a printable page, pure frontend; export is done via the browser print function.
